en: Why have you remained here? Why do{SAUT}you fight?
Ah... Do you still have business with me?
Yeah, there's somethin' we gotta take{SAUT}care of before we head out.
Sorry to trouble you, but we're going to{SAUT}need you to release everyone in the{SAUT}theaters.
You told us we could leave, but there's{SAUT}no way we can just abandon the other{SAUT}people here.

Hikari-san, your presence can't mean{SAUT}you actually agree with them, could it?{PAGE}Aren't you just forcing yourself to do{SAUT}this despite how you truly feel because{SAUT}you're following the others?
That's not true. I'm here of my own{SAUT}will.
*sigh* All this, after I kindly permitted{SAUT}everyone to leave?{PAGE}Then you can no longer be helped.{SAUT}Allow me to show you a glimpse of{SAUT}the real world...
